request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin raft: the pale hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows lashed with rope and a gunmetal scrap plate; the red tarp becomes patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with stitched hide patches; two small wooden barrels sit beside the cargo; the pennant becomes a brown rag. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
